facts.fact: The Agencia de Protecao de Dados is listed as the body that opened a public consultation on the draft revision of Law 22/11, from 17 March to 17 April 2025.
The consultation page treats Law 22/11 of 17 June, the Lei de Protecao de Dados Pessoais, as the existing law whose revision is under way.
The Agencia de Protecao de Dados put the draft revision of the data protection law out for public consultation from 17 March to 17 April 2025.
facts.system: Projecto de Revisao da Lei n.o 22/11

facts.fact: The Agencia de Protecao de Dados is the body listed as running the consultation on the revision.
The Agencia de Protecao de Dados posted the draft revision of the data protection law on the consultation portal consultapublica.gov.ao for public comment from 17 March to 17 April 2025.
The Agencia de Protecao de Dados submitted the draft revision of the data protection law to public consultation, open to entities and society at large, from 17 March to 17 April 2025.
